title: A Comparison of Document Clustering Techniques
authors: Michael Steinbach; George Karypis; Vipin Kumar
venue: University of Minnesota; Technical Report TR 00-034
key_findings: Bisecting K-Means outperformed standard K-Means and hierarchical clustering in many tested settings.
gap: Experiments on English documents; sensitivity to initialization; Vietnamese segmentation not investigated.
relevance_to_project: Classical clustering baseline using TF-IDF and K-Means.

title: VnCoreNLP: A Vietnamese Natural Language Processing Toolkit
authors: Thanh Vu; Dat Quoc Nguyen; Dai Quoc Nguyen; Mark Dras; Mark Johnson
method: Vietnamese Word Segmentation; POS; NER; Dependency Parsing
metric: F1; Accuracy; LAS; UAS; Processing Speed
key_findings: VnCoreNLP provides Vietnamese NLP components with strong reported segmentation accuracy and processing speed.
gap: Does not directly evaluate downstream unsupervised news topic clustering.
relevance_to_project: Provides motivation for Vietnamese word segmentation and preprocessing variants.

title: Learning the Parts of Objects by Non-negative Matrix Factorization
authors: Daniel D. Lee; H. Sebastian Seung
key_findings: Non-negative factors support additive representations; text experiments illustrate interpretable semantic features.
gap: Does not report topic coherence, ARI or NMI for Vietnamese news.
relevance_to_project: Theoretical foundation for the NMF topic modeling baseline.

title: An Analysis of the Coherence of Descriptors in Topic Modeling
authors: Derek O'Callaghan; Derek Greene; Joe Carthy; Padraig Cunningham
dataset: BBC; Guardian; New York Times; Wikipedia
key_findings: Descriptor weighting and topic representation influence measured coherence and interpretability.
gap: Results depend on corpus, descriptor weighting and evaluation configuration.
relevance_to_project: Supports evaluation and comparison of NMF and LDA topic keywords.
evidence_location: Sections 3-5; Tables 1 and subsequent evaluation tables

title: Latent Dirichlet Allocation
authors: David M. Blei; Andrew Y. Ng; Michael I. Jordan
dataset: C. elegans abstracts; Associated Press news
key_findings: LDA represents documents as mixtures of latent topics and improves held-out perplexity against selected probabilistic baselines.
gap: Bag-of-Words assumption; predefined topic count; no Vietnamese news evaluation.
relevance_to_project: Foundation for M07 LDA pipeline and M08 topic experiments.

title: Exploring the Space of Topic Coherence Measures
authors: Michael Roder; Andreas Both; Alexander Hinneburg
dataset: 20 Newsgroups; Genomics; NYT; RTL-NYT; RTL-Wiki; Movie
metric: C_V; NPMI; UMass; Pearson Correlation with Human Ratings
key_findings: Topic coherence configuration strongly affects agreement with human topic judgments.
gap: Automatic coherence does not replace human evaluation or directly measure cluster stability.
relevance_to_project: Supports coherence evaluation and interpretation of LDA/NMF results.

title: BERTopic: Neural Topic Modeling with a Class-based TF-IDF Procedure
key_findings: BERTopic combines semantic clustering with class-based keyword representation.
gap: Limited multi-topic assignment; keyword redundancy; results require validation on Vietnamese data.
relevance_to_project: Supports semantic topic discovery and BERTopic pipeline.

title: Using LLM for Improving Key Event Discovery: Temporal-Guided News Stream Clustering with Event Summaries
authors: Nishanth Nakshatri; Siyi Liu; Sihao Chen; Dan Roth; Dan Goldwasser; Daniel Hopkins
method: Temporal Clustering; HDBSCAN; Dense Embeddings; LLM Summarization
metric: Coverage; Entity Purity; Entity Coherence; Human Evaluation
key_findings: Temporal guidance and summaries can improve event coherence while creating coverage trade-offs.
gap: Requires timestamps and LLM resources; evaluated primarily on English-language news.
relevance_to_project: Supports distinction between broad news topics and time-specific events.

title: A Comparative Analysis of Topic Reduction Techniques for BERTopic
authors: Wannes Janssens; Matthias Bogaert; Dirk Van den Poel
method: BERTopic Topic Reduction; Agglomerative Clustering; LLM
dataset: Trump Tweets; COVID-19 Tweets; Yelp Reviews
metric: NPMI; Topic Diversity; Outliers; Runtime; Token Usage
key_findings: Topic reduction methods involve trade-offs among coherence, diversity, outliers and computational cost.
gap: Limited datasets; lacks human evaluation and statistical significance testing.
relevance_to_project: Supports BERTopic hyperparameter analysis and topic merging.
